Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of arbitrary code execution or data leakage.
</details>

<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The provided patch modifies a meson.build file by removing code that retrieves the Git revision hash from a subproject directory (`subprojects/wn`) and uses it to set a version variable (`WN_FILE_VERSION`). The removed code also included installing Python source files from the subproject into the package's data directory.

This change simplifies the build configuration by eliminating dynamic version detection via Git commands during build time. Removing calls to `find_program('git')` and associated `run_command` invocations reduces potential attack surface related to executing external tools and fetching runtime-derived metadata, though such usage was not inherently malicious.

The modifications are consistent with normal build system maintenance—removing unnecessary or unused logic. There is no evidence of malicious code insertion, obfuscation, unauthorized network access, or data exfiltration. The changes affect only internal build configuration and do not introduce security risks.
</details>
